relative_mean_bias_definition: 100 * (mean(forecast) / mean(variance_proxy) - 1); negative means mean underforecasting, not mean relative error across individual dates
calibration_best_criterion: smallest absolute final-holdout mean bias, not proven overall forecast winner
timing_scope: robustness to one-session stale inputs; does not verify point-in-time vendor delivery or revisions
date_basis: User-supplied original Aug 2026 start; calibration and audit continued to Oct 13, project remains ongoing
